_comment: MCP server manifest. Points at the lakebase-mcp-server bin shipped by this package. Read by Claude Code (this IS the plugin/marketplace manifest) AND by external clients (Claude Desktop, OpenAI Codex, Cursor when using MCP). The path uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}: Claude Code resolves it to the installed plugin dir at launch (a RELATIVE path fails — Claude Code launches the server from a cwd that is NOT the plugin dir, so 'node ./dist/...' throws module-not-found and the stdio connection closes). Source: apps/mcp-server/.
_targets: Cursor (when using MCP rather than skill plugin)
_install: 1. From a clone: `npm install && npm run build` (npm `prepare` builds dist/).
2. Add this server to your client's MCP config – for Claude Desktop, copy the entry below into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json under `mcpServers`.

3. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is substituted by Claude Code only. For an EXTERNAL client (Claude Desktop / Codex / Cursor), replace ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with the absolute path to this package's install/clone dir (the dir containing dist/).

Note: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk is an OPTIONAL peer dep of this package – kept out of regular `dependencies` so consumers that only import the substrate's TypeScript modules (like lakebase-scm-extension) don't drag the MCP runtime into their node_modules. The dev install in step 1 picks it up via devDependencies.
